skills.name: Door Crossing
skills.description: Elegantly reads a book in the library. Good effects on allies.  *ATK Speed +200% (10 sec) *Evade Rate +30% (10 sec) *Area Magical DEF +30000 (10 sec)

skills.name: El Minya
skills.description: With Subaru, pierces enemies with Yin Magic. Bad effects on enemies.  *ATK per sec x 300% Area Damage (7 sec) *Changes Fire elemental enemies to None (7 sec) *Changes Wood elemental enemies to None  (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Re:ZERO
abilities.description: Re:ZERO Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Knockback: Strength
abilities.description: Has a high chance of knocking back all Strength type enemies and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
